mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mcp_usage_log (request_id, virtual_key_id, api_key_hash, gateway_id, traffic_type, tool_or_model, channel_id, status, duration_ms, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, cost, tags, cache_hit, client_ip, session_id, created_at) VALUES (#{requestId}, #{virtualKeyId}, #{apiKeyHash}, #{gatewayId}, #{trafficType}, #{toolOrModel}, #{channelId}, #{status}, #{durationMs}, #{promptTokens}, #{completionTokens}, #{cost}, #{tags}, #{cacheHit}, #{clientIp}, #{sessionId}, NOW())

INSERT INTO mcp_usage_daily (stat_date, virtual_key_id, tool_or_model, channel_id, call_count, fail_count, total_duration_ms, token_sum) VALUES (#{statDate}, #{virtualKeyId}, #{toolOrModel}, #{channelId}, #{callCount}, #{failCount}, #{totalDurationMs}, #{tokenSum}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE call_count = call_count + VALUES(call_count), fail_count = fail_count + VALUES(fail_count), total_duration_ms = total_duration_ms + VALUES(total_duration_ms), token_sum = token_sum + VALUES(token_sum), updated_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO mcp_usage_daily (stat_date, virtual_key_id, tool_or_model, channel_id, call_count, fail_count, total_duration_ms, token_sum) VALUES (#{statDate}, #{virtualKeyId}, #{toolOrModel}, #{channelId}, #{callCount}, #{failCount}, #{totalDurationMs}, #{tokenSum}) ON CONFLICT (stat_date, virtual_key_id, tool_or_model, channel_id) DO UPDATE SET call_count = mcp_usage_daily.call_count + EXCLUDED.call_count, fail_count = mcp_usage_daily.fail_count + EXCLUDED.fail_count, total_duration_ms = mcp_usage_daily.total_duration_ms + EXCLUDED.total_duration_ms, token_sum = mcp_usage_daily.token_sum + EXCLUDED.token_sum, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select:
SELECT id, request_id, virtual_key_id, api_key_hash, gateway_id, traffic_type, tool_or_model, channel_id, status, duration_ms, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, cost, tags, cache_hit, client_ip, session_id, created_at FROM mcp_usage_log
ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limitCount} OFFSET #{limitStart}

SELECT DATE(created_at) AS statDate, COUNT(*) AS callCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status != 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failCount, SUM(cost) AS costSum FROM mcp_usage_log
AND tags LIKE CONCAT('%,', #{tag}, ',%')
AND created_at >= CONCAT(#{fromDate}, ' 00:00:00')
AND created_at <= CONCAT(#{toDate}, ' 23:59:59')
GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY statDate ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN cache_hit = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hits FROM mcp_usage_log WHERE traffic_type = 'LLM'
AND created_at >= CONCAT(#{fromDate}, ' 00:00:00')
AND created_at <= CONCAT(#{toDate}, ' 23:59:59')

SELECT DATE(created_at) AS statDate, COUNT(*) AS callCount, SUM(cost) AS costSum FROM mcp_usage_log WHERE cost IS NOT NULL
AND created_at >= CONCAT(#{fromDate}, ' 00:00:00')
AND created_at <= CONCAT(#{toDate}, ' 23:59:59')
GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY statDate ASC

choose.when:
SELECT t.tag AS dim, SUM(u.call_count) AS callCount, SUM(u.cost_sum) AS costSum FROM ( SELECT tags, COUNT(*) AS call_count, SUM(cost) AS cost_sum FROM mcp_usage_log WHERE cost IS NOT NULL AND tags IS NOT NULL
AND created_at >= CONCAT(#{fromDate}, ' 00:00:00')
AND created_at <= CONCAT(#{toDate}, ' 23:59:59')
GROUP BY tags ) u JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT tags, SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(tags, ',', n.n), ',', -1) AS tag FROM mcp_usage_log JOIN (SELECT 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6) n ON n.n <= LENGTH(tags) - LENGTH(REPLACE(tags, ',', '')) - 1 WHERE tags IS NOT NULL ) t ON t.tags = u.tags GROUP BY t.tag ORDER BY costSum DESC LIMIT #{top}
choose.otherwise:
SELECT tool_or_model AS dim, COUNT(*) AS callCount, SUM(cost) AS costSum FROM mcp_usage_log WHERE cost IS NOT NULL
AND created_at >= CONCAT(#{fromDate}, ' 00:00:00')
AND created_at <= CONCAT(#{toDate}, ' 23:59:59')
GROUP BY tool_or_model ORDER BY costSum DESC LIMIT #{top}

mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN cost IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unpriced FROM mcp_usage_log WHERE traffic_type = 'LLM'
AND created_at >= CONCAT(#{fromDate}, ' 00:00:00')
AND created_at <= CONCAT(#{toDate}, ' 23:59:59')

SELECT DATE(created_at) AS statDate, virtual_key_id AS virtualKeyId, tool_or_model AS toolOrModel, COUNT(*) AS callCount, SUM(prompt_tokens) AS promptTokens, SUM(completion_tokens) AS completionTokens, SUM(cost) AS costSum, MAX(tags) AS tags FROM mcp_usage_log WHERE traffic_type = 'LLM'
AND created_at >= CONCAT(#{fromDate}, ' 00:00:00')
AND created_at <= CONCAT(#{toDate}, ' 23:59:59')
AND virtual_key_id = #{virtualKeyId}
AND tags LIKE CONCAT('%,', #{tag}, ',%')
GROUP BY DATE(created_at), virtual_key_id, tool_or_model ORDER BY statDate ASC, virtual_key_id ASC, tool_or_model ASC
